complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down the 'User Product Tracking Interface' into subtasks. Create separate tasks for the core tracking UI components (track/untrack buttons), the price alert configuration modal, the integration with the subscription service to enforce limits, the real-time price update mechanism, the price history chart visualization component, the bulk track/untrack functionality, and ensuring the entire interface is mobile-responsive.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: High complexity due to the combination of frontend UI/UX, real-time data handling, business logic for subscription tiers, and data visualization. Each major feature is a significant piece of work.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Decompose the 'Advanced Search & Discovery System' into subtasks. Create tasks for the search bar UI with debounced auto-complete, the filter panel component, the backend API for search queries including filtering and sorting, the implementation of the search relevance scoring algorithm, the 'recently viewed' feature using local storage, and the search analytics tracking.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Complexity comes from both the frontend implementation (responsive filters, debounced auto-complete) and the backend search engine logic (indexing, filtering, relevance scoring). Performance is a key concern.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down the 'User Dashboard Enhancement' into subtasks. Create separate tasks for the main tracked products grid, the price history chart widget, the savings calculator and statistics display, the wishlist management system, the implementation of quick actions on the dashboard, the data export (CSV/PDF) functionality, and the dashboard layout customization feature.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: This is a complex data aggregation and visualization task. It requires fetching and combining data from multiple sources and presenting it in various forms (grids, charts, stats). Each widget is a sub-project.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Expand the 'Mobile Responsiveness & PWA' task. Create subtasks for auditing and implementing mobile-first responsive CSS across all components, creating a mobile-specific navigation pattern, implementing the service worker for caching and offline support, creating the web app manifest file, and setting up the infrastructure for push notifications.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Complexity arises from the need to apply changes across the entire codebase (responsive design) and the technical challenges of implementing PWA features like service workers and offline caching.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down the 'Real-Time Price Alert System'. Create subtasks for the alert configuration UI, the backend logic for evaluating price triggers, the email notification integration, the push notification integration, the in-app notification component, and the alert history and management dashboard.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: This task has high backend complexity. It requires a reliable, scalable system to monitor price changes, evaluate complex user-defined rules, and integrate with multiple third-party notification services.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Decompose the 'Social Features & Sharing' task. Create subtasks for implementing standard social media share buttons, developing the shareable product lists feature with public/private settings, building the product review and rating system, creating the community deal submission feature, and implementing a basic friend system.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium complexity. While individual features are simple, creating a cohesive system with privacy controls (public/private lists) and user-generated content (reviews, deals) introduces significant data modeling and backend logic.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down the 'AI-Powered Recommendations' task into research and implementation subtasks. Create tasks for developing the data pipeline for user behavior, building and training a personalized product recommendation model, creating a price prediction model using historical data, developing an API to serve these results, and integrating them into the UI.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Very high complexity due to the reliance on data science and machine learning. This goes beyond typical web development and requires expertise in algorithms, data modeling, training pipelines, and model deployment.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Decompose the 'Multi-Currency Support' task. Create subtasks for integrating a real-time currency exchange rate service, creating a global price display component that handles conversion, updating all backend calculations to be currency-aware, implementing user currency preferences, and adapting the price alert system to handle multiple currencies.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: The complexity lies in its cross-cutting nature. Every part of the application that displays or calculates a price must be updated. It requires a reliable third-party data source and careful implementation to avoid errors.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down the 'Advanced Analytics Dashboard'. Create subtasks for setting up the data pipeline for analytics events, building the admin dashboard UI, developing the cohort analysis and revenue tracking modules, implementing the A/B testing framework, creating the custom report generation feature, and ensuring data privacy compliance.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: High complexity due to large data volumes and the need for sophisticated data processing and aggregation. Building a flexible A/B testing framework and a custom report generator are significant engineering challenges.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Expand the 'API Development & Documentation' task. Create subtasks for designing the OpenAPI specification, implementing API authentication (e.g., OAuth2) and rate limiting, developing the core RESTful endpoints, building the webhook delivery system, generating interactive API documentation from the spec, and creating a developer portal for API key management.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: The complexity comes from creating a product for other developers. This requires high standards for security, reliability, performance, and documentation. Features like authentication, rate limiting, and webhooks are non-trivial.
